entry.title: Volvo Design Gems: The nature of Volvo design

media:group.media:title: Volvo Design Gems: The nature of Volvo design
media:group.media:description:
Some of our best design inspiration is hiding in plain sight. A rock you might walk past. A sound you barely notice. The way light interacts with the world around us. Nature is a big part of our Scandinavian heritage, and an endless source of inspiration for our designers.
But inspiration is only the beginning. What we find outside is brought back to our studio in Gothenburg, where it's explored, interpreted and refined sometimes becoming a shape, a colour, a sound or a material inside one of our cars.
Volvo Cars Design Gems uncovers the thinking and craftsmanship behind details like these: the small things you might never notice, but that have been designed with a purpose. The things that make a Volvo, Volvo.

entry.title: Meet the new Volvo XC60 long-range plug-in hybrid

media:group.media:title: Meet the new Volvo XC60 long-range plug-in hybrid
media:group.media:description: The Volvo XC60, our all-time best-seller, is now better than ever. Join Tom Lynch, the car’s communications manager, for an in-depth tour of the new XC60 long-range plug-in hybrid. With a new design, updated safety technology and a paradigm-shifting electric range of up to 200km, no journey is ever out of reach in the XC60.

entry.title: The New Volvo XC60 & XC90 | Long-Range Plug-in Hybrids

media:group.media:title: The New Volvo XC60 & XC90 | Long-Range Plug-in Hybrids
media:group.media:description:
While we’re firmly committed to an all-electric future, the road to electrification isn’t one-size-fits-all. We know many customers want the benefits of electric driving, but like having the reassurance that no journey is ever out of reach. Our new Volvo XC60 and XC90 long-range plug-in hybrids offer exactly that: the best of both worlds.
The electric range of the XC60 (up to 200 km) and XC90 (up to 160 km) is now more than two and a half times as high as on the existing plug-in hybrid variants. These long-range hybrids are a key part of our bridge to a fully electric future. Together with the all-electric EX60, they give us the strongest electrified offering in the mid-size SUV segment.

entry.title: The Volvo XC90 Plug-in Hybrid. Ready for every journey.

media:group.media:title: The Volvo XC90 Plug-in Hybrid. Ready for every journey.
media:group.media:description:
The Volvo XC90 long-range plug-in hybrid gives you the best of both. Drive on electric power for everyday trips and switch seamlessly to hybrid power for longer journeys, now with an extended electric range.
Range figures are preliminary and based on WLTP testing standards obtained under specific testing conditions for the Volvo XC90. Actual range can vary depending on charge level, vehicle specification, outdoor temperature, battery temperature, weather, topography, driving style and vehicle speed.
